nodes.label: Data Source Priority
nodes.rationale: Analytics should be reproducible from the local database, with WB API synchronization used only to fill missing fresh coverage.

nodes.label: Database Access Priority
nodes.rationale: Prefer report services, repositories, views and aggregates over heavy ad-hoc access to raw tables.

nodes.label: Documentation Update Rule
nodes.rationale: Each fact should have one canonical home so handoffs, task lists, state snapshots and logs do not accumulate duplicated or contradictory summaries.

nodes.label: Graphify Memory Workflow
nodes.rationale: Graphify is a derived navigation index; ordinary work should use the lightest useful read-only path and maintenance should be explicit and batched.

nodes.label: Session Startup Rule
nodes.rationale: Keep startup context small by loading handoff and current-task documents only when continuity or recent status is relevant.

nodes.label: Advertising Sync Tolerates Empty Responses and Period Limits
nodes.norm_label: advertising sync tolerates empty responses and period limits
nodes.rationale: Expected null datasets and WB period-limit responses should be normalized, chunked and aggregated rather than treated as system failures.

nodes.label: Article Versions Preserve Historical Identity
nodes.rationale: A simple rename under an existing nmId mixes physically different products and distorts historical profitability.

nodes.label: Dashboard Follows Selected Account
nodes.rationale: Account context must persist across dashboard and navigation transitions.

nodes.label: Database Is the Analytics Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: database is the analytics source of truth
nodes.rationale: Database-first analytics is more reproducible and resilient than live ad-hoc WB API reads.

nodes.label: Documentation Is Split into Three Canonical Zones
nodes.norm_label: documentation is split into three canonical zones
nodes.rationale: Root, core, development, marketplace and archive zones let each role load relevant context without duplicating common architecture.

nodes.label: Financial-Report Advertising Uses Spend History Totals
nodes.norm_label: financial-report advertising uses spend history totals
nodes.rationale: Using different sources for the total and article allocation produced internally inconsistent advertising rows despite a plausible total.

nodes.label: Graphify Is Read-Only by Default
nodes.rationale: Mandatory per-task synchronization loaded expensive semantic workflows, while saving query results into Graphify memory triggered self-referential re-ingestion.

nodes.label: Post-Handoff FBS KIZ Association Is Preserved
nodes.norm_label: post-handoff fbs kiz association is preserved
nodes.rationale: Detaching canceled or defective post-handoff orders from KIZ codes created a false risk of duplicate marking.

nodes.label: Production Releases Require Explicit Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Production deployment changes external state and therefore must remain owner-controlled, verifiable and recoverable.

nodes.label: Project Memory Has Current and Archive Layers
nodes.norm_label: project memory has current and archive layers
nodes.rationale: Separating bounded current context from detailed history prevents semantic duplication, conflicting next steps and oversized startup context.

nodes.label: Reports Table Owns Scrolling and User Column Order
nodes.norm_label: reports table owns scrolling and user column order
nodes.rationale: Large reports should keep controls, headers and totals visible while preserving each user's preferred column order.

nodes.label: Russian Employee Ingress Avoids Cloudflare Response Path
nodes.norm_label: russian employee ingress avoids cloudflare response path
nodes.rationale: Large Next.js assets failed through Cloudflare for affected Russian IPv4 networks while local and Tailscale delivery remained healthy.

nodes.label: Automation Logic Uses Stable Sheet Roles
nodes.norm_label: automation logic uses stable sheet roles
nodes.rationale: Renaming a Google Sheet tab must not silently alter the workflow meaning, so runtime depends on stable semantic roles rather than display names.

nodes.label: Sync Kinds Use One Flexible Time Model
nodes.norm_label: sync kinds use one flexible time model
nodes.rationale: Different artificial scheduling restrictions by sync kind complicated the UI and scheduler semantics.

nodes.label: Batch Graph Maintenance
nodes.rationale: Maintenance is most efficient after accumulated substantial changes, before large refactors or on a periodic cadence rather than after every task.

nodes.label: Graphify as Project Map
nodes.rationale: The graph accelerates navigation across connected files and components but cannot replace code, canonical documentation, database evidence or production logs.

nodes.label: Lightest Useful Graphify Mode
nodes.rationale: Known components should be inspected directly, while broad cross-subsystem questions may justify one bounded read-only query followed by source verification.

nodes.label: Graphify Source of Truth Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Implementation, decisions, contracts, work state, detailed history, graph relationships and production state each have a distinct authoritative source.

nodes.label: Graphify Token and Time Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Bounded queries, scoped source reads and avoiding self-reingested saved results prevent unnecessary token use and secondary maintenance cycles.

nodes.label: Schedule Fingerprint Midnight Drift Root Cause
nodes.norm_label: schedule fingerprint midnight drift root cause
nodes.rationale: Legacy daily schedules normalized an unused anchorDate to the current Moscow date, and fingerprints serialized that irrelevant field, causing jobs to appear replaced after midnight.

nodes.label: Archive Precedence Rule
nodes.rationale: Archived material is historical and active canonical documents take precedence when they conflict.

nodes.label: Startup Navigation
nodes.rationale: Only startup essentials and task-relevant documents should be loaded to keep orientation bounded.

nodes.label: Documentation Storage Rules
nodes.rationale: Stable truth, current work, detailed history, incidents and superseded material belong in distinct canonical locations.
